name: The Daplorabulls

evidence.note: Band post: high-energy 6-piece band of dance, soul, funk and disco.
Eleanor's Lounge residency: come dance the night away with the band.
Channel of live covers such as I Love the Nightlife, Hot Stuff and You Should Be Dancing.

dancing.notes: Bills itself as a party and dance band and invites crowds to dance the night away; its videos are mostly disco and funk covers like Hot Stuff and Play That Funky Music.

description: Six-piece Long Island party band playing dance, soul, funk and disco covers, with a twice-monthly 'Feel Good Fridays' night at Eleanor's Lounge in Bohemia.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Popei's Clam Bar has Coram and Deer Park locations; Ira's List says Coram.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Facebook not confirmed: facebook.com is blocked by robots.txt for our checks, and an Oct 2024 event posted by the 'TheDaplorabulls' Facebook page (HappeningNext copy) announced 'our new name OFF THE HOOK' (offthehookli.com, facebook.com/offthehookli). But Off The Hook's own site lists a different lineup, and venues still book 'The Daplorabulls' in 2025-2026, so they look like separate bands now. The current facebookUrl (facebook.com/TheDaplorabulls) may now belong to Off The Hook - owner should check it while signed in; I left it out. No website, Instagram or booking contact found. Logo is the YouTube profile picture. No band photos from an official source (only venue/flyer images). Current description still fits.

logo.alt: Bass drum head printed with The Daplorabulls logo, a bull in a red no-symbol with music notes, and the words Long Island's Party Band

evidence.note: Lily's Babylon lists 'Happy Hour Band: The Daplorabulls' on Fri Nov 6, 2026, 6-10 PM, at 345 Deer Park Ave, Babylon.
Eleanor's Lounge (Bohemia): 'Feel Good Fridays' with the Daplorabulls, a Long Island party and dance band, every 2nd and last Friday, 8-11 PM, $5 cover; runs Oct 2025 to Apr 2027.
The Other Room (Deer Park) billed 'Long Island's Party Band The Daplorabulls' with six named members (May 2024).
YouTube channel 'The Daplorabulls'; its profile picture is the band logo reading 'Long Island's Party Band'.

factsSource: Checked October 4, 2026. Sources: lilyflanaganspub.com, eleanorslounge.com, theotherroomli.com, youtube.com.
